# Living room dashboard

Run a room without opening a dialog. Switches, sliders, steppers, speeds and your own scene buttons sit right on the cards ([controls](/cards/controls)), [rules](/cards/entity-options#rules) colour every value, and gauges, columns, bars and curves show where it stands. Every card runs against a simulated home, so tap, drag and hold them.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Living room
      subtitle: "{{ states('sensor.living_room_temperature') }} °C · {{ states('sensor.living_room_humidity') }} % humidity · {{ states('sensor.living_room_co2') }} ppm CO₂"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:entity-sections-card-pro
          title: Scenes & modes
          icon: mdi:palette
          vertical_align: center
          hover: true
          view_layout: { span: [2, 4] }
          show_value: false
          sections:
            - layout: row
              align: stretch
              name_position: below
              entities:
                - { entity: scene.bright, name: Bright, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny, color: amber, control: button }
                - { entity: scene.dimmed, name: Dimmed, icon: mdi:lightbulb-on-50, color: orange, control: button }
                - { entity: scene.dinner, name: Dinner, icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife, color: deep-orange, control: button }
                - { entity: scene.movie_night, name: Movie, icon: mdi:movie-open, color: deep-purple, control: button }
            - layout: row
              divider: true
              align: stretch
              name_position: below
              entities:
                - { entity: input_boolean.night_mode, name: Night, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: indigo }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
                - { entity: input_boolean.guest_mode, name: Guests, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: pink }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
                - { entity: input_boolean.away_mode, name: Away, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: blue }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
                - { entity: input_boolean.vacation_mode, name: Vacation, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: teal }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
          name: Temperature
          icon: mdi:thermometer
          view_layout: { span: [1, 4] }
          layout: poster
          decimals: 1
          visual: sparkline
          hours_to_show: 24
          rules:
            - { below: 18, color: blue, label: Cool }
            - { below: 24, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_humidity
          name: Humidity
          icon: mdi:water-percent
          view_layout: { span: [1, 4] }
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: gauge
          min: 0
          max: 100
          rules:
            - { below: 40, color: amber, label: Dry }
            - { below: 60, color: teal, label: Good }
            - { above: 60, color: blue, label: Humid }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.living_room
          name: Ceiling
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.living_room', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
          rules: &light
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.desk_lamp
          name: Desk lamp
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.desk_lamp', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
          rules: *light
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.dining_table
          name: Dining table
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.dining_table', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          tap_action: { action: toggle }
          rules: *light
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: cover.living_room_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:blinds-horizontal
          layout: poster
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          color: indigo
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_co2
          name: Air
          icon: mdi:molecule-co2
          layout: poster
          decimals: 0
          visual: columns
          hours_to_show: 12
          bucket_minutes: 30
          rules:
            - { below: 800, color: green, label: Fresh }
            - { below: 1200, color: amber, label: Stuffy }
            - { above: 1200, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: climate.living_room
          name: Thermostat
          layout: poster
          attribute: current_temperature
          unit: °C
          decimals: 1
          visual: bar
          min: 15
          max: 28
          control: stepper
          color: deep-orange
          badges:
            - entity: climate.living_room
              attribute: hvac_action
              rules:
                - { state: heating, color: deep-orange, icon: mdi:fire, label: Heating }
                - { state: idle, color: grey, icon: mdi:fire-off, label: Idle }
                - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:power, label: "Off" }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: fan.living_room
          name: Fan
          layout: poster
          attribute: percentage
          unit: "%"
          control: segments
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: cyan }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
        - type: custom:layout-card-pro
          rows: [1fr, 1fr, 1fr]
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: media_player.living_room_tv
              name: TV
              icon: mdi:television-play
              attribute: media_title
              color: deep-purple
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
              name: Speaker
              icon: mdi:speaker
              attribute: media_title
              color: green
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: switch.coffee_machine
              name: Coffee machine
              icon: mdi:coffee
              control: toggle
              control_position: lead
              color: brown
```

</DashboardGrid>
